name: LiteWebSynth
author: adminkov

sections.description:
LiteWebSynth turns any WordPress page or post into a full-featured browser music workstation using the Web Audio API and local browser-based AI.

Key Features

  • AI Audio-to-MIDI Converter (100% Private & Local): Convert MP3 and WAV files into editable MIDI tracks directly in the browser via Spotify’s Basic Pitch and TensorFlow.js without external uploads.
  • Built-in AI Composer: Generate original ~3-minute MIDI compositions directly with the built-in AI tool.
  • Multi-Track MIDI Sequencer & Editor: Full support for Type 0 and Type 1 MIDI files, note editing, CC parameters, and timing adjustments.
  • Sheet Music Generation & Printing: Render musical notation with support for multiple clefs and direct browser printing.
  • GM, GS & XG Sound Engine: Real-time synthesis and local .sf2 SoundFont bank loading.
  • Visual Sound Design & Diagnostics: Real-time oscilloscope, AHDSR envelopes, Web Audio API node graph, and RAM usage monitoring.
  • 88-Key Virtual & USB MIDI Keyboard: Play live using your mouse or a hardware USB MIDI controller.
  • Audio Export: Export MIDI projects to MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, M4A, or WMA via API2Convert.

Live Demo & Links

  • Live Synthesizer: https://adminkov.bcr.by/midi/
  • Support: https://adminkov.bcr.by/support/
  • Documentation Users: https://adminkov.bcr.by/wp-content/plugins/litewebsynth/doc/doc_en/litewebsynth_en.html
  • Documentation API: https://adminkov.bcr.by/doc/lws_doc/index.html

You can send a letter to the developer at: klenitskiy.oleg@mail.ru

External Services

This plugin integrates with third-party services and local libraries for audio processing and conversion.

1. API2Convert

  • Purpose & Trigger: Converts MIDI files into various audio formats when the user clicks “Export”.
  • Data transmitted: The source MIDI file and user API key sent to API2Convert.
  • Policies: Terms | Privacy

2. TensorFlow (Local AI Processing)

  • Purpose & Data: Converts WAV/MP3 to MIDI locally in the browser; no data is transmitted to external servers.
  • Resources & Licenses: Uses bundled library (/js/spotify/tf.min.js, source on GitHub).
  • Policies: Google Terms | Apache 2.0 License

3. Spotify Audio Intelligence Lab (Basic Pitch)

  • Purpose & Data: Core local AI models run entirely in the browser; no data is shared with Spotify servers.
  • Project & License: Basic Pitch on GitHub | Apache 2.0 License
sections.installation:
1. Upload the litewebsynth folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the WordPress dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Add the shortcode [LiteWebSynth] to any page or post.
  4. (Optional) Upload shared GS/XG SoundFonts to /wp-content/plugins/litewebsynth/soundFonts/GS/ or /XG/.
sections.faq:
Are my MP3/WAV files uploaded to a server?

No. All transcription runs 100% locally in your browser using TensorFlow.js and Spotify’s Basic Pitch model.

Can I connect a physical MIDI keyboard?

Yes, connect your USB MIDI device before refreshing the page and select it above the oscilloscope.

How do I export MIDI to MP3 or WAV?

Enter a free or paid API key from api2convert.com in the Sequencer settings, then click Export.
